title: Annotatio IV §.II: Institution shows presence and participation — special Mode from Christ & Paul
pass_a_gloss: Since even the words of the Institution of the Sacred Supper sufficiently distinctly insinuate both the presence and the participation of Christ’s body and blood, yet decide nothing about the special Mode of either, so that this whole Mode is to be sought and learned from the said discourses of Christ and Paul, as the only but fullest and most lucid Commentaries.
pass_b_english: Institution words clearly enough hint presence and participation of body and blood — but decide nothing about the special Mode of either.
That whole Mode must be sought from Christ’s and Paul’s discourses as the only, fullest, most lucid commentaries.
source_text: Quandoquidem etiam Institutionis S. Cœnæ verba corporis & sanguinis Christi tùm præsentiam, tum participationem satis distinctè insinuant, de Modo tamen utriusque speciali decernunt nihil, ut hic totus ex dictis Christi & Pauli sermonibus, ceu unicis quidem sed plenissimis ac luculentissimis Commentariis, petendus ac addiscendus veniat.
notes: Mode not in Institution; from commentaries.
